Assassin's Strike.oracle_text: Destroy target creature. Its controller discards a card.

Crypt Lurker.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature or discard a creature card. If you do, draw a card.

Death's Approach.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets -X/-X, where X is the number of creature cards in its controller's graveyard.

Double Vision.oracle_text: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

Dutiful Attendant.oracle_text: When this creature dies, return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

Entomber Exarch.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, choose one —
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature card from it. That player discards that card.

Fell Specter.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, target opponent discards a card.
Whenever an opponent discards a card, that player loses 2 life.

Goblin Wizardry.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 red Goblin Wizard creature tokens with prowess. (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, they get +1/+1 until end of turn.)

Gonti, Lord of Luxury.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
When Gonti enters, look at the top four cards of target opponent's library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest on the bottom of that library in a random order. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.

Hungry Flames.oracle_text: Hungry Flames deals 3 damage to target creature and 2 damage to target player or planeswalker.

Kinetic Augur.oracle_text:
Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
Kinetic Augur's power is equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
When this creature enters, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.

Lightning Visionary.oracle_text: Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)

Living Lightning.oracle_text: When this creature dies, return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.

Masked Blackguard.oracle_text:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
{2}{B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

Nocturnal Feeder.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature dies, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.

Ravenous Chupacabra.oracle_text: When this creature enters, destroy target creature an opponent controls.

Stab Wound.oracle_text:
Enchant creature

Defender

Flash

As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.

Thriving Moor.oracle_text:

{T}: Add {B} or one mana of the chosen color.

Tinybones, Trinket Thief.oracle_text:

  - **Copies your first instant/sorcery spell each turn**, which can **double your damage output** (e.g., **Hungry Flames** or **Living Lightning**).

  - **Long-term value**—can generate **multiple copies** of key spells.
- **Cons:**
  - **5 mana** is a **big investment**, but you have the mana available.
  - **Doesn’t immediately impact the board**, but sets up **future turns**.

**Verdict:** **Cast Double Vision.** It’s a **high-impact play** that enables **future turns** and synergizes with your **Thermo-Alchemist** and **instant/sorcery spells**.

annotations.description: Mulliganed a keepable 7-card hand with 2 lands, two 2-drops (Tinybones, Wight), card filtering (Thrill of Possibility), removal (Hungry Flames), and perfect color fixing. While 2 lands is on the low side, the curve is very low and Thrill helps find more lands. Going to 6 is a meaningful cost.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. With two 2-mana plays, Thrill of Possibility to dig for lands, and a low curve, this hand is functional even if you only draw one more land in the first few turns.

annotations.description: Casting Alchemist's Gift on Thieves' Guild Enforcer during the precombat main phase when the Enforcer is summoning sick (just entered this turn) accomplishes very little. The +1/+1 buff is temporary (until end of turn), and since the Enforcer can't attack or block this turn, the spell is essentially wasted. The opponent has no attackers threatening damage this turn either. This burns a useful combat trick for no meaningful benefit.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Alchemist's Gift on summoning-sick Thieves' Guild Enforcer with no combat or defensive purpose.
annotations.betterLine: Hold Alchemist's Gift for a future turn when it can be used as a combat trick during actual combat — either to win a favorable trade on attack/block or to grant deathtouch to kill a larger creature. The single black mana could have been left open or the card simply held in hand.

annotations.description: Chose lifelink on Thieves' Guild Enforcer instead of deathtouch. The Enforcer doesn't currently have deathtouch (opponent only has 2 cards in graveyard, not 8), so choosing deathtouch would have made it a much more threatening blocker/attacker that can trade with any creature. Lifelink on a 2/2 provides marginal life gain at best.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose lifelink for Alchemist's Gift on Thieves' Guild Enforcer
annotations.betterLine: Choose deathtouch - it makes the Enforcer a genuine threat that can trade with any creature, providing far more value than 2 life from lifelink

annotations.description: Cast Gonti, Lord of Luxury before playing the Swamp from hand. By playing the land first, they would have had 5 mana available, leaving 1 mana open after casting Gonti. That floating mana could be relevant for any instant-speed card Gonti exiles from the opponent's library, or for future responses.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Gonti, Lord of Luxury with only 4 lands untapped, using all available mana.
annotations.betterLine: Play Swamp first, then cast Gonti, Lord of Luxury, leaving 1 black mana open for potential instant-speed plays (including whatever card Gonti might exile from the opponent's library).

annotations.betterLine: Cast Lightning Visionary from exile using two Swamps (Gonti allows any mana type), adding a 2/1 prowess creature to the board for additional pressure.
